notes: The mechanic is a grant-budget component on the universe handle plus a legality-mask edge. An absent row means unbounded, which is what every save and every hand-built test world written before it carries, so nothing that worked stops working. The three constants also ship at values no run can reach, because the grid holds 300 nodes and only prerequisite-free ones in permitted cells are grantable. WORLD_SCHEMA_VERSION moved 5 to 6 -- material-stock holds revision 5 -- and sim-core's SNAPSHOT_VERSION did not move; no golden fixture diffs and goldens:regen was never run.

Measured in tools/w69 over four full 2400-tick runs per strategy: archivist sees action 8 masked for affordability on 4307 of 4804 ticks and for an empty candidate list on zero of them; denial-warden is closed by an empty list on 3508 ticks, having forbidden the grid; narrow-depth sees it legal on 76 percent of its ticks and asks zero times, because encourageResearch sits ahead of it and policyFor takes the first legal preference. Only uniform-random-legal ever grants, and it landed 1 grant from 234 submissions -- the other 233 were admitted by the mask and refused by the rules, because foundingKnowledgeCandidates excludes a node only when this mage holds it while grantPlan refuses any node with an instance anywhere.
rationale: Re-recorded after merging main. The refusal was provenance, not a metric breach: provenance.contentHash moved because this tree is the first holding both mains grant-budget constants and this branchs dailyRelevance on all seventy cells. Every metric was inside tolerance before regeneration -- the five-year gate reported delta 0.00000 (0.00 SE) on all ten, and the twenty-year and agency gates refused on the hash alone and never compared a metric. No tolerance was set and --tolerance-k was never passed, so every tolerance here is k times the measured standard error with k unchanged at 3. These numbers are a measurement and not a balance claim: release-plan.md forbids any balance claim before 0.5.0, and this file is evidence about one build rather than an assertion that the build is balanced. The universe remains degenerate in known ways -- among them that the three gates resolve zero raids, that no strategy in the pool submits god action 8 at any budget, and that no committed gate varies species or tradition -- so a metric that does not move here has not been shown to be inert, only to be out of this instruments reach.
